lines.say: The idea: train a body part, and the fat on top of it melts. It's called spot reduction.
Scientists tested it. People did ab exercises five days a week for six weeks. Their belly fat didn't change.
Another study trained just one leg for twelve weeks. Fat dropped, but mostly from the arms and upper body, not that leg.
Your body chooses where it burns fat from. You can't pick the spot.
Verdict: myth. To lose belly fat, lose fat overall: eat a little less, lift, move more, and sleep.
Crunches still build your abs. You'll see them when the fat comes off.
